projects.name: BOOSTAR
projects.subtitle: Emergency communication, connected.
projects.imageAlt: Public BOOSTAR website introducing emergency reporting and authorised monitoring
projects.summary: Public safety technology connecting emergency alerts, location information and authorised response workflows.
projects.overview: BOOSTAR (Boost Alert and Response) helps the public reach emergency numbers, share distress information and report safety concerns. Its public app is complemented by BOOSTAR-M, a controlled monitoring platform for authorised personnel.
projects.problem: In an emergency, people can struggle to find the right response channel or explain their location. Reports also need a clear path from the person raising an alert to the team reviewing it.
projects.contribution: My role included mobile application development and work across alert, location, reporting and response workflows. My professional work also covered authentication, notifications, dashboards, monitoring, backend/API functionality, testing, debugging and continuous upgrades.
work: Backend/API functionality, testing and ongoing upgrades
projects.challenge: The system connects public-facing reporting with controlled monitoring. Keeping those workflows understandable and reliable is a central technical concern.
projects.approach: My work spans the mobile interface and supporting system workflows, with testing, debugging and continued upgrades as part of delivery.
projects.status: Professional project with a public website and ongoing system upgrades. This case study describes my areas of contribution without attributing the entire platform to me.

projects.name: NFEC
projects.subtitle: Fire safety, made traceable.
projects.imageAlt: NFEC public website showing its fire extinguisher registration and verification programme
projects.summary: Registration, verification and administrative software supporting fire extinguisher records and compliance workflows.
projects.overview: Nigeria Fire Extinguisher Control (NFEC) brings together technology infrastructure, validation tools, vendor records and data capture for fire extinguisher registration and tracking.
projects.problem: Fire extinguisher records need to be captured consistently, verified and made useful to the teams handling registration, inspections and compliance tracking.
projects.contribution: My role was on the software and technology side. My work included registration, QR/code verification, vendor records, compliance tracking, inspections, data capture, administration, dashboards and database/system functionality.
work: Fire extinguisher registration and data capture
projects.challenge: Registration and verification depend on clear data capture and consistent records across related workflows.
projects.approach: My contributions focused on the software used to capture, manage, verify and review records. Policy and regulatory responsibilities remain with the relevant authorities.
projects.status: Professional software work associated with the public NFEC programme. No policy or regulatory function is claimed as my individual contribution.

projects.name: N-Alerts
projects.subtitle: A clearer path from report to response.
projects.imageAlt: N-Alerts mobile public complaint screen with agency selection
projects.summary: Mobile reporting workflows within a public safety platform for emergency communication and coordinated response.
projects.overview: N-Alerts is a public safety and emergency reporting platform. Its public website describes a reporting and response ecosystem connecting citizens, communities and relevant agencies.
projects.problem: People need a practical way to submit safety concerns and emergency information, including location details, to the appropriate response channels.
projects.contribution: As a Mobile App Developer, my role included registration, emergency alert/reporting workflows, location-based functionality and security/emergency communication. I also worked on testing, feature improvements and maintenance.
features: Public reporting through a mobile interface
projects.challenge: The mobile experience needs to make reporting understandable while supporting location and communication requirements.
projects.approach: My work focused on mobile application workflows, followed by testing, troubleshooting, maintenance and feature improvements.
projects.status: Professional project developed as part of my employment. The public website provides broader platform context; this case study focuses on my mobile work.

projects.name: NFDRC
projects.subtitle: Making fire data useful.
projects.summary: Data repository, administration and reporting work for national fire data management.
projects.overview: The National Fire Data Repository Center (NFDRC) concerns national fire data collection, repository systems, data management, analytics and reporting. This description is based on the professional information I have provided.
projects.problem: Fire data needs structured collection, management and reporting to support the departments and agencies working with it.
projects.contribution: My role included work on national fire data collection, repository systems, data management, analytics, reporting, administrative systems and backend/database functionality supporting department and agency coordination.
work: Workflows supporting department and agency coordination
projects.challenge: Data systems must make collected information manageable and useful to the teams responsible for reporting and administration.
projects.approach: My contributions covered backend/database functionality and the administrative and reporting workflows around the data.
projects.status: Professional project. The supplied public URL could not be independently verified during this portfolio build, so no additional architecture, functionality or outcomes are inferred. No matching public screenshot is included.

projects.name: BANT
projects.subtitle: A place for campus conversations.
projects.summary: A voice chat and social platform for university students. MVP — In Development.
projects.overview: BANT is my own product: a voice chat and social platform aimed at university students. The concept centres on joining topic-based voice rooms to talk, learn and connect with other students.
projects.problem: The product explores how students can find conversations and communities around campus life, shared interests and learning.
projects.contribution: I am creating and developing the BANT MVP. It is an ongoing product project, rather than a finished or launched service.
work: Building and iterating on the MVP
Exploring topic-based voice rooms and social interaction
features: Text chat and student social interaction as part of the concept
projects.challenge: The current task is turning a student conversation concept into a usable MVP. Features remain subject to development and iteration.
projects.approach: Develop the MVP, test the experience and refine the product. The demo is a development preview, not evidence of a completed launch.
projects.status: MVP — In Development. No user, revenue, traction or launch figures are claimed.
